dividedAttention.name: Divided Attention
dividedAttention.description: Track central and peripheral objects simultaneously
dividedAttention.instructions1: A symbol will flash in the center while a target appears at the periphery.
dividedAttention.instructions2: 1. Identify the central object (Car or Truck)
dividedAttention.instructions3: 2. Tap where the peripheral target appeared
dividedAttention.instructions4: The display gets faster as you improve!

doubleDecision.name: Double Decision
doubleDecision.description: Quick decisions about direction under time pressure
doubleDecision.instructions1: A car will flash on a road while a sign appears at the periphery.
doubleDecision.instructions2: 1. Decide which direction the car is going (Left or Right)
doubleDecision.instructions4: Time pressure increases as you improve!
doubleDecision.whichDirection: Which direction was the car going?

comprehension.name: Comprehension
comprehension.description: Read, understand, and summarize current news
comprehension.instructions1: Read an article carefully in your chosen language.
comprehension.instructions2: Answer comprehension questions to test your understanding.
comprehension.instructions3: Write a brief summary to practice expressing key ideas.

iconSwap.name: Icon Swap
iconSwap.description: Spot the icon that changed after a brief blink
iconSwap.instructions1: A set of icon cards will appear briefly.
iconSwap.instructions2: After a quick blink, one icon will be different.
iconSwap.instructions4: The viewing time gets shorter as you improve.

speedSummary.name: Speed Summary
speedSummary.description: Quickly summarize a news paragraph in 10–20 words
speedSummary.instructions1: Read a short paragraph in your chosen language.
speedSummary.instructions2: Summarize it in 10–20 words as quickly as you can.
speedSummary.instructions3: Accuracy and speed both count toward your score.

tenseRewrite.name: Tense Rewrite
tenseRewrite.instructions1: You'll see sentences with a grammatical transformation to apply.
tenseRewrite.instructions2: Rewrite each sentence with the correct tense, mood, or structure.
tenseRewrite.instructions3: Accuracy of grammar and spelling are both evaluated.

verbFill.name: Verb Fill
verbFill.description: Fill in the correct verb conjugations in context
verbFill.instructions1: Read a short story with missing verb forms.
verbFill.instructions2: Fill in each blank with the correct conjugation.
verbFill.instructions3: Pay attention to tense, subject, and context clues.

cardRecall.name: Card Recall
cardRecall.description: Memorize a sequence of playing cards and recall them in reverse
cardRecall.instructions1: Playing cards will appear one at a time.
cardRecall.instructions3: Then recall them in REVERSE order by tapping the cards.
cardRecall.instructions4: Sequences get longer as you improve.

sentenceMemory.name: Sentence Memory
sentenceMemory.description: Memorize and reproduce sentences with exact spelling and punctuation
sentenceMemory.instructions1: A sentence will appear on screen for you to memorize.
sentenceMemory.instructions2: After it disappears, type it back exactly — including accents and punctuation.
sentenceMemory.instructions3: You'll complete 10 rounds at your chosen difficulty level.
sentenceMemory.placeholder: Type the sentence exactly as you remember it...

oralWriting.name: Oral Writing
oralWriting.description: Listen to a text and write it down with exact spelling and punctuation
oralWriting.instructions1: A short text will be read aloud — it will not appear on screen.
oralWriting.instructions2: Listen carefully and type exactly what you hear, including punctuation and accents.
oralWriting.instructions3: Use the playback controls to adjust speed, pause, or replay the audio.
oralWriting.pacedMode: Paced mode — follows your writing speed
oralWriting.waitingForYou: Waiting for you to catch up...
oralWriting.notSupported: Your browser does not support text-to-speech. Please try a different browser.

wolvesAndWool.name: Wolves & Wool
wolvesAndWool.description: Turn the flock, outwit the pack — a turn-based logic puzzle

progress.title: Your Progress
progress.noSessions: No sessions yet. Play a game to see your progress!

about.description: A cognitive training platform with interactive brain games designed to boost thought processing abilities, attention, and language comprehension.
about.feature1: Adaptive difficulty that adjusts to your performance across 20 levels
about.feature2: Detailed progress tracking with charts and statistics
about.feature3: Multilingual support — English, French, Chinese, and Hebrew
about.feature4: AI-powered feedback for reading comprehension summaries
